mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_SMS_AUTH A USING (SELECT #{companyCode} AS COMPANY_CODE, #{phone} AS PHONE FROM dual) B ON (A.PHONE = B.PHONE AND A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AUTH_CODE = #{authCode}, EXPIRE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP + (5/1440) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COMPANY_CODE, PHONE, AUTH_CODE, EXPIRE_TIME) VALUES (#{companyCode}, #{phone}, #{authCode}, SYSTIMESTAMP + (5/1440))
mapper.select: SELECT AUTH_CODE FROM TB_SMS_AUTH WHERE PHONE = #{phone} AND EXPIRE_TIME > SYSTIMESTAMP
